basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming and spacious condo, ideally located in Duboce Park Historic District. The flexible layout includes two comfortable bedrooms, a split bath, formal dining room, gracious living room and a separate office - perfect for working from home, hosting guests, or creating additional living space. Beautiful, original architectural details add warmth and character throughout, while the updated kitchen is both functional and thoughtfully designed, featuring modern appliances, generous cabinet storage, and a layout that makes everyday cooking and entertaining easy. Enjoy the added bonus of  direct garden access - a peaceful outdoor space to start your day with a cup of coffee or unwind with some fresh air. Located just steps from Duboce Park, cafes, restaurants, shops, and public transit, this neighborhood earns a Walk Score of 98. Everything you need is within easy reach. This home offers the perfect blend of classic San Francisco charm and modern convenience, in one of the city's most beloved and sought after communities.
